draftCoach.comfortNeedsTeam: Choose your team under Team scouting to use its recorded picks. Without a team, no comfort evidence is applied.
draftCoach.experimentalEstimate: Experimental draft-edge estimate — not a validated win forecast
draftCoach.experimentalEstimateHint: Held-out tests have not established a reliable advantage over simple baselines. Do not use this percentage as a professional match prediction.
draftCoach.observedInterval: 95% sampling interval: {low}–{high}%. A wide range means limited evidence; this is not a forecast. Games from the same teams may be correlated.
draftCoach.quickSetupHint: Choose your competition, evidence window and pick order. Start when ready.
draftCoach.dataScope: {games, plural, one {# eligible game} other {# eligible games}} · {from} — {to} · View data coverage
draftCoach.scopeHint: Recommendations, combinations and matchups use the same selected region, map and date window, relative to the snapshot update. No ranked tier-list scores. Game patch versions are not supplied by the source: this is recent tournament evidence, not a verified single-patch dataset.
draftCoach.excludedEvidence: Excluded: {missing} games without a date · {invalid} invalid, conflicting or unresolved · {duplicate} duplicates · {outside} outside the selected window / season. No automatic fallback to older results.
draftCoach.noRecommendations: Not enough eligible evidence for this decision. You can choose any unused hero in the Hero Pool or change the evidence window. No recommendation is invented.
draftCoach.playbookHint: Each core appeared together in at least three eligible games. Choosing it adds a small preference to future picks, never locks heroes or overrides filled roles. This is observed compatibility, not proof of a winning strategy. Shorter/longer games are only a rough guide to pace.
draftCoach.coreBlocked: Core interrupted by an enemy pick or ban — its ranking bonus is paused. Choose an alternative below.
draftCoach.coreRecord: {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} · {wins} W / {losses} L
draftCoach.coreRate: {rate}% observed wins · used by {teams, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}}
draftCoach.noBlueprints: No repeated core fits these picks and bans in the selected data. Individual role recommendations remain available; we will not invent a combination.
draftCoach.banContextEvidence: Current-season pro context: {synergy, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} alongside enemy picks · {matchups, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} against your picks
draftCoach.sampleGames: {count, plural, one {# recorded game} other {# recorded games}}
draftCoach.resultEvidence: Selected region / map: {games, plural, one {# completed game} other {# completed games}} · {wins} wins · {losses} losses
draftCoach.noResolvedResults: No confirmed results for this hero in the selected sample.
draftCoach.contextEvidence: Current-season pro context: {synergy, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} with your picks · {matchups, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} against the opposing picks
draftCoach.evidenceCaveat: Each game counts once per measure. Context uses the same selected region, map and date window, and is not added to the hero's sample. Association is not proof of a counter; ranking smooths small samples and also considers open roles.
draftCoach.title: Draft Coach
draftCoach.description: Choose a region and game plan, then log every pick and ban. The coach recalculates the meta, counters and team tendencies after every move — and explains why.
draftCoach.proofDescription: Recommendations use dated, complete pro drafts with confirmed results. Review the evidence before trusting a decision.
draftCoach.setupDescription: Every choice changes the recommendation weights, and confidence drops automatically when the sample is thin.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.description: Cover all five roles with stable, proven picks.

early.title: Early pressure
early.description: Pick early pressure; bans target the strongest late-game answers.

scaling.title: Late game
scaling.description: Pick for late game; bans remove the opponent's early pressure.

counter.title: Counter draft
counter.description: Let enemy picks strongly reshape the answer.

comfort.title: Team comfort
comfort.description: Prioritise the selected team's draft identity.

draftCoach.pickOrderHint: MPL practice flow: 3 bans, 3 picks, 2 bans, 2 picks.
draftCoach.allyBrief: The ranking is recalculated for the “{plan}” plan, role coverage and the counters currently available.
draftCoach.enemyBrief: These are the opponent's most likely options from the meta, team profile and response to your draft. Log the move that actually happened.
draftCoach.openRoles: Best option for every open role
draftCoach.requiredRole: Role needed to complete the composition
draftCoach.priorityPickHint: These are your plan's strongest available picks, so the coach removed them from your ban list.
draftCoach.duoHint: Pairs actually played across every active pro league this season, prioritising role coverage and packages containing a Mid pick.
draftCoach.duoProof: {games, plural, one {# game together} other {# games together}} · {rate}% estimate
draftCoach.counterMapTitle: Best answer to {hero} in every role
draftCoach.chooseCounterTarget: Choose the enemy pick to answer
draftCoach.observedCounter: {games, plural, one {# matchup} other {# matchups}} · {rate}% estimate
draftCoach.counterMapHint: All five roles stay visible for comparison, but a filled role is locked and cannot add a duplicate. Direct counters use current-season matchups only.
draftCoach.emptyTitle: Choose a plan and press start
draftCoach.emptyDescription: After the first ban, every move is reranked with reasons, confidence and sample size.
draftCoach.completeDescription: All five picks and bans are logged for both teams. Undo one move or start a new draft.
draftCoach.comparisonDescription: Compare observed hero results, shared compositions and matchups in the selected data. These indicators do not measure player skill or prove which team will win.
draftCoach.comparisonEvidence: Based on {games, plural, one {# current-season game} other {# current-season games}} · {confidence}
draftCoach.comparisonDisclaimer: This is a draft comparison, not a calibrated win probability or a guarantee. Player skill, economy and in-game decisions are not included.
draftCoach.heroPoolEyebrow: Every hero in the live patch
draftCoach.heroPoolHint: The role filter only narrows the list. You may manually record any available hero for free-form practice; automatic recommendations still protect role coverage.
draftCoach.methodNote: Decision fit is a heuristic ranking, not a calibrated win probability. Picks, results and combinations use the selected competition and date window. Unknown dates/results are excluded. Ranked tier lists do not affect recommendation scores. Source pick slots describe roles, not historical pick order. Game duration is only a pace proxy. The source does not identify each game's patch; data refresh is scheduled. This beta still needs prospective coach validation before claims of competitive advantage.
draftCoach.noDataHint: The coach will activate automatically when the tournament snapshot is published.
